title: Complete executable ingest-protocol@1 acceptance pack
description: After the Operator confirms the amended draft, add shared positive and negative vectors under the RFC 8785 encoding rule plus executable Python and TypeScript acceptance tests, verify every tested Interface name, demonstrate genuine RED, and present the exact pack binding for a separate Operator freeze approval.
design: The protocol Module remains pure and transport-independent. Tests consume one shared vector inventory across TypeScript and Python; Kotlin is excluded under amended ADR 0040. HTTP, persistence, encryption, and Health Connect behavior remain owned by later scopes. Claude implements (reassigned from Codex on 2026-10-11).
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement in packs/ingest-protocol-1.spec.md maps to an executable test; shared vectors cover the closed message union and named failures; runner configuration is included in the proposed binding; RED is reproducible against the pre-implementation tree; Vouch remains unfrozen until explicit Operator authorization.
notes: 2026-10-12: Executable pack drafted and genuinely RED. Added protocol/v1 wire reference (README), JSON Schema, deterministic vector generator, 172 vectors across 7 files plus manifest (all 20 named failures exercised), Python Interface stub and 41 unittest acceptance tests, TypeScript Interface stub (sender/protocol) and 26 node:test acceptance tests, and tests/acceptance/run_ingest_protocol_1.sh. RED: runner exits 1; Python 35 Interface tests fail with NotImplementedError only (6 contract/schema/fixture/inventory tests pass); TypeScript 376 checks fail on the stub only. Pinned jsonschema==4.26.0 dev dependency; .node-version 26. Removed lifecycle state from bound files (pack status line, contract freeze_state). Proposed binding: 17 files, label ingest-protocol-pack/1@b6854f36b78b174c; pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .node-version deliberately unbound (adoption log 2026-10-12). Awaiting Operator freeze decision.
close_reason: Executable pack drafted, shown genuinely RED, and its 17-file binding (ingest-protocol-pack/1@b6854f36b78b174c) approved for freeze by the Operator on 2026-10-12.

title: Review ingest-protocol@1 draft contract
description: The Operator must review governance/scopes/ingest-protocol.1.json and packs/ingest-protocol-1.spec.md, either approving their semantic requirements and proposed failure vocabulary or requesting amendments. This is review of the draft only and does not authorize Vouch freeze.
design: Operator owns semantic adequacy. Claude (reassigned from Codex by the Operator on 2026-10-11) drafts the contract and proposed test inventory. Vouch remains at specified until the executable pack receives a later explicit freeze approval.
acceptance_criteria: The Operator records approval of the draft requirements or identifies every required amendment; no acceptance pack is frozen by this decision alone.
notes: 2026-10-11 Operator review: all 20 proposed amendments accepted and applied to the pack, contract, CONTEXT.md, ADRs 0003/0007/0009/0031/0040, scope map, and README. Key outcomes: RFC 8785 encoding with integer-only envelope numbers and strict noncanonical refusal; defined enrollment and Ingest Batch item shapes; identity fields inside hashed bytes; server-side gap reporting plus sequence-out-of-order; greedy partitioning; one hash chain per cycle; valid empty pages and cycles; completion-identity-mismatch and completion-sequence-gap added; closed checkpoint value lists that grow only by wire version; checkpoint-health-data-forbidden removed; capability acknowledgement is an ordered Outbox Message and limits are evaluated per staging generation; three compatibility outcomes; receipt-mismatch and closed retryable reasons; every error tagged with an outcome class; Python and TypeScript only. Roles reassigned to Claude. Pending: Operator confirmation of the amended revision, including five details filled in while writing (cycle kind on fragments, omit rather than null, exact chain formula, generation-retirement framing of R10, record-too-large reason).
close_reason: Operator approved the amended ingest-protocol@1 draft on 2026-10-12, including the five details filled in while applying the review. Approval authorizes the executable pack work only; it does not freeze the pack.

title: Create HTML architecture plan
description: Create a standalone, responsive HTML plan for the personal health and activity portal. Cover Amazfit/Health Connect and food ingestion, canonical processing, pluggable persistence with SQLite first, portal capabilities, privacy, risks, and phased delivery.
design: Use a self-contained static document with semantic HTML and embedded CSS; no runtime dependencies. Treat HealthifyMe as an optional/manual import unless its Health Connect nutrition output is verified.
acceptance_criteria: A self-contained HTML document exists in the repository, presents the end-to-end architecture and delivery phases clearly, is responsive and accessible, and passes basic HTML/link validation.
notes: Created architecture-plan.html as a dependency-free responsive HTML document. Covers architecture boundaries, source matrix, canonical model, deterministic processing, storage ports and SQLite schema, portal concept, privacy, delivery phases, feasibility gates, decision log, and primary references. Validated HTML structure with html5validator; modern embedded CSS warnings from its legacy CSS parser were excluded.
close_reason: Completed standalone responsive architecture plan and validated HTML structure and internal anchor links.
